transcript.text: Now that you've signed up, we're going to show you some of the core features that you can start using right away.

transcript.text: Typically, a meeting will be processed within five to ten minutes at the latest after it finishes.

transcript.text: That's great. What is the usual processing time for a one hour meeting?

transcript.text: Now, if I want to search across this meeting in an even faster way, instead of just searching across the transcript, I can use the smart search filter on the left hand side here.

transcript.text: Does it automatically identify the action items?

transcript.text: So as I'm going through the meeting and I'm at a particular part of the meeting, let's say at 26 minutes in, I want to leave a comment saying review this again.

transcript.text: Is it possible to share specific soundbites instead of the whole recording?
